features.summary: Compare the active Agent setup with a saved Profile in two isolated runs before Apply.

states.idle: Compare is available only for a saved Profile with an implemented Agent capability.
states.working: The initiating command and dialog report preparation and both isolated runs.
states.success: The result distinguishes Agent now from With Profile and persists one bounded report.
states.error: Failure identifies the affected run and preserves the real Agent and selected Workspace.
states.cancelled: Cancellation stops the child process and removes temporary homes and workspaces.
states.noOp: A Profile that matches the active Agent does not offer a redundant comparison run.
states.stale: A changed Agent or selected folder invalidates the result without writing either source.
states.partial: Excluded resources are visible and the result is labelled incomplete.
states.persisted: Only the latest redacted bounded report is stored in device-local data.
states.rollback: Temporary resources are removed and no real Agent or Workspace mutation requires recovery.

features.summary: Review a linked Skill collection, prepare every affected Agent, and move only the outer shared link.

contract.anchor: A Skill collection link is one physical migration boundary.

states.idle: The outer collection is summarized as one review boundary with member progress.
states.working: Per-member or batch decisions expose local progress without dismissing the parent review.
states.success: Exact collection intent is saved and deployed without applying unrelated Profile changes, then only the reviewed outer link is moved.
states.error: The failing member or Agent remains visible in the collection dialog and completed review decisions are retained safely.
states.cancelled: Closing review before migration performs no filesystem mutation.
states.noOp: A saved active Profile may remain globally pending; unrelated changes are neither required nor applied.
states.stale: Changed collection content, active Profile identity, or Profile content receipts require a fresh in-dialog review before mutation.
states.partial: Incomplete member decisions or an unsaved affected Profile stay in the parent dialog with the next executable action.
states.persisted: Member version decisions and path ownership boundaries are stored independently.
states.rollback: A verified backup restores the outer link and every affected Agent destination after failure.
